chapter.verse: Tua hi a, Khris Jesu sunga omte' tungah gawtna tung lo hi.
A hang pen nuntakna a pia Kha in note Khris Jesu tungtawnin mawhna leh sihna thukhun pan hong suaktasak khinzo hi.
Pasian in cilesa hanga a thazawm thukhun ii sep zawhloh thu sem khinzo hi. Amah in a Tapa, mawhphel biakpiakna ahi dingin cilesa tawh hong sawl a, tua tawh cilesa sunga om mawhna' tungah thukhen hi.
Tua pen cilesa' deihna zui lo-in Kha' deihna tawh a kalsuan eite' sungah thukhun' hong kalh thute a kicin nading ahi hi.
A hang pen cilesa' deihna tawh a nungtate in cilesa thute mah ngaihsutin nei uh a, Kha' deihna tawh a nungtate in Kha thute ngaihsutin nei uh hi.
Cilesa lungsim puakzia pen sihna hi a, Kha lungsim puakzia pen nuntakna leh nopna lemna ahi hi.
Cilesa lungsim puakzia pen Pasian tawh kigalneih ahih manin Pasian' thukhun nuai-ah niamlut lo a, zong niamlut theilo hi.
Cilesa sunga omte in Pasian lungkimsak theilo uh hi.
Ahi zongin note pen na sung uhah Pasian' Kha hong teen takpi leh cilesa sunga om na hikei uh hi. Khris ii Kha a neilo peuhmah Khris' mi hilo hi.
Ahi zongin note' sungah Khris hong om leh mawhna huhau-in na pumpi uh a sih hangin Kha ahihleh dikna thu hangin nuntakna ahi hi.

Misite lakpan Jesu a thokiksak Pasian' Kha note' sungah hong teen-a leh misite' lakpan Khris Jesu a thokiksak tua Pasian in a sithei note' pumpi zong note' sunga hong teeng Kha tungtawnin hong nungtasak ding hi.
Tua ahihleh sanggamte aw, eite pen cilesa paizia tawh a nungta dingin cilesa lamah leiba i nei kei hi.
A hang pen cilesa paizia tawh na nuntak uhleh na si ding uh a, ahi zongin na pumpi gamtatnate uh Kha tungtawnin na sihsak uhleh na nungta ding uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian' Kha in a makaih mite Pasian' tate ahi uh hi.
A hang pen launa sungah a pukkik dingin sila suahna kha a ngah na hikei uh a, ta suahsakna Kha ngah khinzo-in tua Kha hangin “Abba! Pa aw!” ci-in i sam hi.
Eite, Pasian' tate i hihna thu Kha mahmah in eimau' kha tawh teci pangkhawm hi.
Tua hi a, tate i hihleh gamhluahte—Pasian' gamhluahte, Khris tawh gamhluahkhawmte—i hi a, tua pen amah tawh gimna i thuakkhop takpi leh amah tawh minpha i ngahkhop theih nading ahi hi.
Eite' tunga hong kilang ding minphatna vangtaang tawh ka teh ciangin tu laitaka gimthuaknate cihtaak ka sa kei hi.
A hang pen piansak leitung in Pasian' tate a kilatkhiat ding hun lawpin a ngak ahi hi.
Piansak leitung pen khiatna neilo dinmun ah om a, tua pen ama' ut thu tawh hilo-in a koihpa' hang hizaw hi. Lametna khat tawh a koih hi a,
piansak leitung mahmah muattheihna' sila hihna pan kikhahkhia-in Pasian' tate' ngah vanglian minpha tawh kidim suahtakna ngah ding cih lametna ahi hi.
A hang pen tu ciangdong mah nausuak natna thuak bangin piansak leitung bup taukhawmin om cih i thei hi.
Piansak leitung bek hilo-in Kha anpal a malep eite mahmah in zong Pasian' ta dinmun tunna ahi, i pumpi hong kitatkhiat ding hun, lawptak i ngak laitak i sunglam ah khuisa-in i om hi.
A hang pen hih lametna hangin eite in hotkhiat a ngah i hi hi. Lametna cih pen mitmuhin om hileh lametna hilo hi. Kua in a muh gige khat lamen lai ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, i muhloh a lamen i hihleh lungduaitak ngakin i om hi.
Tua mah bangin i thanemna mun ah Kha in hong huh hi. Eite in thungetzia ding nangawn i thei kei a, ahi zongin Kha mahmah in lawhkhiat theihloh tauna tawh eite' ading hong thumsak hi.
Kha in Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin mi siangthote' adingin taangmi thunget hong neihsak ahih manin lungsim sungtawng a entelpa in Kha lungpuak zong thei hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' ngimna tawh kituakin sapkhiatna a ngah, amah a it mite' adingin na khempeuh in a hoih a pian nadingin semkhawm uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian in ama' teelkholh mite, ama' Tapa' limlemel a sun dingin a sehkholh hi a, tua pen sanggam tampite lakah tacila a suah theih nading ahi hi.
Tua a sehkholh mi teng mah samkhia-in tua a sapkhiat mi teng mah diksakna pia a, tua diksakna a piak mi teng mah pahtawi-in sanglap hi.
Tua ahihleh hih thute ah bang i gen lai ding hiam? Ei' lamah Pasian hong pang peuhleh ei' langah kua pang zo ding ahi hiam?
Eite khempeuh' ading ama' Tapa ngiat iksik lo-in hong piakhiapa in nate khempeuh zong a khawnkhongin a Tapa tawh hong pia-khawm lo-in om ding ahi hiam?
Pasian' teeltuam mite kua in thu bawl ding ahi hiam? A diksak pen Pasian ahi hi.
Gawtna a pia ding kua ahi hiam? Khris Jesu pen a sipa bek hilo-in a kithokiksakpa hi a, Pasian' taklam ah tu-in eite' adingin taangmi thunget hong neihsak ahi hi.
Kua in eite Khris' itna tawh hong khenkham ding ahi hiam? Gentheihna, haksatna, bawlsiatna, gilkialna, puan kisilhsapna, lauhuaina, namsau, cihte ahi ding hiam?
Hih bangin a kigelh om hi, “Kote in nang' adingin sun thapai sihtheihna ka tuak uh a, tuu kigo dingte bangin hong kibawl hi.”
Hilo hi. Eite pen ei hong itpa' hangin hih thute khempeuh ah gualzopente i hi hi.
A hang pen ka lungmuan thu ah: sihna ahi-a nuntakna ahi zongin, vanmite ahi-a gam-ukte ahi zongin, tu-a om nate ahi-a hong tung ding nate ahi zongin, vangliante ahi zongin,
a sangna mun ahi-a a thukna mun ahi zongin, piansak leitung bup sunga nadang khatpeuh ahi zongin, bangmah kuamah in eite pen i Topa Khris Jesu sunga Pasian' itna tawh hong khenkham zolo ding hi.
